summary: Listed on Forest Lookouts in Manatee County, FL, and in a Florida tower list with coordinates; no readable source gives build, staffing, fate or site status.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists Kibler as a lookout in Manatee County
Forest Lookouts page title and address spell the name Kibbler
Florida tower list places Kibler at 27.47417, -82.23694 in Manatee County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page is a stub: a heading, the county and one banner photo with no credit, so it gives no history. The tower list gives a name, coordinates and an elevation of 94 with no unit stated. No readable source gives build date, design, height, staffing, fate or access, so the story is under the 120-word floor; it may be better held until a county or Florida Forest Service record is found. Search results about a 2026 mosquito-control helicopter crash into a private radio tower in Myakka City came up for this site; nothing links that tower to this record, so they are not used. Spelling: the tower list and the record use Kibler, and the Forest Lookouts URL uses Kibbler.
